rationale: Given the Chief Justice’s central role in framing a narrow, institutionally cautious holding grounded in § 524(e) and the limits of §§ 105(a)/1123(b)(6), Roberts is the most likely author, with Barrett/Kavanaugh as plausible assignees for a text-and-structure opinion. Separate concurrences are most likely from Gorsuch (textual/negative-implication emphasis) and Alito/Thomas (equity-limits and separation-of-powers), with lower probabilities for others to add victim-focused or pragmatic caveats.
